files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added

- App Store screenshot gallery for the maintenance dashboard, item overview,
  repeat-limit tasks, and fuel tracking, using the public GitHub image URLs.

### Fixed

- npm production advisory audit: bump vite to ^7.3.7 (lockfile 7.3.8) and
  override transitive follow-redirects to 1.16.3 so scheduled
  `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` passes (GHSA-q3jh-wrc6-jgq8,
  GHSA-8r9p-f939-6h3c, GHSA-mrwp-f3q8-3g9p, GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm and related
  vite/launch-editor advisories). Left the moderate webdav/minimatch chain
  alone (force-fix would break @nextcloud/dialogs).

### Changed

- Release workflow uses separate qualified Node/npm/Python and PHP toolchains,
  verifies all packaging tools, and supports safe retries of existing version
  tags from main without retagging. Existing release assets must match exactly.

- Public App Store metadata (`website`, `repository`, documentation, privacy
  policy link, and author homepage) now points at the GitHub mirror
  ([thystra/maintenance_tracker](https://github.com/thystra/maintenance_tracker)),
  because Forgejo is not open for outside registration. Bug reports were
  already on GitHub.
